sloka: काम मोह अभिभूतस्य विघ्नो अयम् प्रत्युपस्थितः ।स विनिःश्वसन् मुनिवरः पश्चात्तापेन दुःखितः ॥१-६३-१२॥
transliteration: kāma moha abhibhūtasya vighno ayam pratyupasthitaḥ ।sa viniḥśvasan munivaraḥ paścāttāpena duḥkhitaḥ ॥1-63-12॥

translations.english: "O Rama Viswamitra, the best of ascetics sighed with repentance, distressed with grief. On seeing him, the apsara started trembling in fear. She stood before him with folded palms. (But) with sweet words the son of Kushika left her and proceeded towards the northern mountains.
translations.hindi: सब देश के ऋषि तो आ भी चुके हैं, पर महोदय नामक चषि नहीं आए। इनके अतिरिक्त वसिष्ठ जी के सव पुत्रों ने महाक्रद्ध हो जो कवाच्य
